snippet.title: Toxic Dream: Noxia Somnia Ultima Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278940/Toxic_Dream/

The definitive version of the cult psychological horror-action game. Return to the shadowy dreamscape where reality twists and nightmares fight back.

Toxic Dream: Noxia Somnia Ultima features:
- Remastered environments & character models
- New nightmare mechanics and enemy types
- Deepened story content and alternate endings
- Reimagined UI/UX for a smoother, more intense experience

A haunting blend of lucid dreaming, combat, and psychological unraveling, Toxic Dream challenges you to survive not just the horrors outside — but the ones within.
